name: Ruins of León Viejo
description: León Viejo, on the shore of Lake Xolotlán in western Nicaragua, was founded in 1524 and is one of the oldest Spanish colonial towns in the Americas. After earthquakes and ash from the neighbouring Momotombo volcano, settlers moved the city about 30 km west, and the old site lay buried until 1967. Today you can walk its grid of streets and partly restored ruins around the main square.
